profile.summaryJa: ガトの王で、マアカの子と記されています。列王記上2:39で、シムイの逃亡奴隷がこの王のもとへ逃れます。

facts.textJa: シムイはガトへ行き、アキシュのもとから逃亡した奴隷を連れ戻します。

primaryWitnesses.textualBasisJa: At the end of three years, two of Shimei’s slaves ran away to Achish, son of Maacah, king of Gath. They told Shimei, saying, “Behold, your slaves are in Gath.”
Shimei arose, saddled his donkey, and went to Gath to Achish to seek his slaves; and Shimei went and brought his slaves from Gath.
